g.text: git-into-gsoc start
│ Four quick questions, then organizations that fit you and what to do next. │
│ Press Enter to skip any question. Your answers stay on this computer. │
GSoC 2027
: Before the program is announced
Next date: Program Announce Date, 2026-12-02 (in 41 days, an estimate)
The best time to start. Pick orgs that participated last year, contribute steadily,
and treat every date as an estimate until Google publishes it.
1 of 4 Your GitHub username? It lets the tool read your public languages.
> (Enter)
2 of 4 Languages and tools you know? For example: python, javascript, java, c++
> python
3 of 4 What would you enjoy working on? Pick numbers or type your own words.
1 science and medicine 8 security
2 AI and machine learning 9 graphics, audio, and video
3 websites and web apps 10 operating systems
4 data and databases 11 education
5 developer tools 12 robotics
6 programming languages and compilers 13 mobile apps
7 cloud and infrastructure 14 games
Separate several with commas
4 of 4 About how many hours a week can you give?
Organizations that fit you
2027 orgs are not announced yet; showing official 2026 participants, the best
predictor of who returns.
Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI)
Machine learning applications in science
Why: Topic: Science and research software; Topic: Data science; Uses Python
3 ideas on its 2026 ideas page
UC OSPO
Amplifying Research Impact through Open Source
Why: Topic: Science and research software; Topic: Data science; Uses Python
74 ideas on its 2026 ideas page
Open Science Initiative for Perfusion Imaging
Open access resources for perfusion imaging
Why: Named after Science and research software; Topic: Science and research
software; Topic: Data science
6 ideas on its 2026 ideas page; of the 5 that state a difficulty: 5 medium
At 8 hours a week its medium ideas need a longer coding period than the
standard 12 weeks; ask the mentors early
At 8 hours a week, a small project (about 90 hours) takes about 12 weeks, and
large projects would not fit in the longest coding period (22 weeks, and only if
your mentor agrees). Choose a small or medium idea and state your hours in the
proposal. Source: https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/faq
Shortlist any of these now? Type their numbers, or press Enter to skip
Your shortlist: Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI)
Your next steps
1. Read Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI) closely: ideas page, chat channels,
past projects
git-into-gsoc org "Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI)"
2. See which of its repositories mentors work in and welcome newcomers
git-into-gsoc repos "Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI)"
3. Whenever you are unsure what to do, ask
git-into-gsoc next
Change your answers any time: run start again, or git-into-gsoc profile.
Prefer an AI assistant? After `git-into-gsoc setup`, ask it in your own words, such
as "Which GSoC issue should I try first?"
